name: Kyle's Gone Missing!

angles.text: As a tauren, you know Ahab Wheathoof as a Bloodhoof Village resident. Helping him is a familiar gesture of community support across Mulgore's pastures.
As a member of the Horde, you strengthen ties with the Shu'halo by helping Bloodhoof's villagers with everyday matters as they settle and defend their homeland.

faq.answer: Ahab Wheathoof is an elder tauren who lives in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. He cares deeply for his prized dog, Kyle, and asks traveling adventurers to find and feed him when he wanders too far from home.
Kyle the Frenzied is Ahab Wheathoof's beloved dog and prized companion. Tender strider meat can calm him and lure him back.
Bloodhoof Village lies in central Mulgore, south of Thunder Bluff. Local tribes, traders, and herders gather there.
faq.q: Where does this task take place?

faq.answer: Kyle has a particular appetite for fresh meat from the plainstriders that wander Mulgore. Tender strider meat pacifies the hungry hound and convinces him to return safely to Ahab.
faq.q: Why does Kyle need tender strider meat?

faq.answer: Locals know Kyle as the Frenzied because he roams the plains when lost or famished. His frenzy subsides once a patient traveler properly feeds him.
Kyle wanders the open plains around Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. Travelers search the nearby prairies until they find him and can offer him a meal.

sections.body:
Ahab Wheathoof is an elder in Bloodhoof Village, and he worries over his wayward pet, Kyle the Frenzied. To outsiders, Kyle's name sounds alarming, but to Ahab he is a prized puppy. He has slipped away onto Mulgore's grassy plains.

Ahab asks travelers passing through the settlement to track down his unruly companion. A hearty meal may calm Kyle's wild spirits.
sections.title: A Missing Hound

sections.body: Kyle needs a cut of tender strider meat from the swift plainstriders roaming Mulgore. The treat satisfies the hungry pup and soothes his frenzied mood. Then it nudges him back toward Bloodhoof Village and his grateful owner.
sections.title: A Simple Remedy

summary: In Bloodhoof Village, Ahab Wheathoof asks you to find his missing dog, Kyle the Frenzied. A cut of tender strider meat calms the hungry pup and guides him safely home.
attribution: In-game quest text: Kyle's Gone Missing!
